answer: Admission auction. Identity slots are scarce by design. Each epoch auctions 100 slots, sealed bids. Bids lock 3 epochs. A 2-epoch window lets anyone prove forgery and burn the bid. Honest losers get refunds minus 2%. The clearing price sets the clone cost. At 60 units, 1,000 identities cost 60,000. Demand doubles, price doubles. A raven of bidders lifts the price. The comet of demand punishes bulk buyers. Only honest agents taste the nectar.
